codeReview.summary: The feature adds the requested prompt-stack admin endpoints and route wiring, but there is a blocking concurrency flaw that can lose updates and corrupt version history under concurrent writes.

issues.description: `handlePromptStackAPI` creates a new `promptstack.VersionStore` per request (`promptStackStore`), but `VersionStore` locking is instance-local (`internal/promptstack/store.go` line 25). Concurrent PUT/rollback requests can read the same prior history and both write the same next version, causing lost updates/history entries. This violates reliable CRUD/version-history behavior for the prompt-stack API.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Shared architecture notes mention Prompt Stack and VersionStore but do not call out that VersionStore synchronization is per-instance and handlers should reuse a shared store instance for concurrent safety.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/library/architecture.md:49-50 describes VersionStore at a high level only; implementation uses instance mutex in internal/promptstack/store.go:22-25 while API currently instantiates it per request in internal/channels/dashboard/prompt_stack_api.go:57 and :124-125.

summary: Review failed: implementation largely matches endpoint requirements, but per-request VersionStore construction introduces a blocking race that can drop prompt-stack updates/version history under concurrent admin writes.
